verdict.rationale: Brex's developer docs use an /openapi/ path structure (transactions_api.md, budgets_api.md, expenses_api.md) suggesting the docs are generated from OpenAPI specs, and an llms.txt exists for AI consumption, but a direct probe for a downloadable machine-readable spec file (openapi.json/swagger.json/.well-known) returned 404 at all standard locations. Missing for 10: a confirmed, directly downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger JSON or YAML file, and any documentation pointing to where such a raw spec can be fetched.
